views.label: All operations
views.alt: Six public binary operations: FloatLib and MPFR time in nanoseconds per operation, by separate layouts below 32 bits. Medians and observed min/max of 3 trials on ordinary inputs, with paired precision and exponent bounds. Logarithmic vertical axes.
